snippet.title: Silent Planet - Elegy of a Dying World Official Trailer | #TheIndiePremier
snippet.description:
Explore the claustrophobic corridors of a vast underground complex in this gothic sci-fi Metroidvania. Confront technological horrors, biological nightmares, and the remnants of a long-dead civilization.

Developed by Vertex Zero and published by Red Dunes Games.
